_comment: Copy this file to mcp_config.json and fill in your MCP server URLs. Each key under 'mcpServers' is a server name that becomes the tool prefix (e.g. mat_sn_search-papers-enhanced). Set the corresponding env vars in your .env file, or replace the ${...} placeholders with actual URLs.

mat_compdart._comment: DART composition optimization GA engine. Set MAT_COMPDART_MCP_URL. Supports Bohrium AppSpace deployments.

mat_doc._comment: PDF/document parser for extracting material data from literature. Set MAT_DOC_MCP_URL.

mat_dpa._comment: DPA machine learning potential for property prediction. Set MAT_DPA_MCP_URL.

mat_electron_microscope._comment: Electron microscopy image recognition. Set MAT_ELECTRON_MICROSCOPE_MCP_URL. Uses SSE transport.

mat_nmr._comment: NMR search, prediction, and reverse prediction tools. Set MAT_NMR_MCP_URL. Uses SSE transport.

mat_sg._comment: Structure generator: bulk, surface, defect, supercell, adsorption, etc. Set MAT_SG_MCP_URL.

mat_sn._comment: Science Navigator: literature paper search (enhanced/normal/scholar). Set MAT_SN_MCP_URL. Uses SSE transport.

mat_xrd._comment: XRD phase identification. Set MAT_XRD_MCP_URL. Uses SSE transport.
